trial_design: Single-arm open-label pediatric safety and pharmacokinetic study
primary_or_supportive_evidence: Part A safety and pharmacokinetics supported expansion of Stage 2 type 1 diabetes indication to patients age 1 and older; NOT a new randomized efficacy endpoint
l1_rationale: FDA S-013 approval letter expressly ties expanded pediatric Stage 2 indication to Part A safety and pharmacokinetic evidence; separate S-010 approval June 12 concerns Stage 3 recently diagnosed patients and must not be conflated.
major_risks: Viral reactivation boxed warning; cytokine release syndrome; serious infections; lymphopenia; small single-arm pediatric safety bridge; April 29 calendar date is not independently verified PDUFA goal
remaining_blocker: Locate FDA or sponsor source verifying original or amended PDUFA goal for S-013; keep S-010 separate
